QEMU emulator version 8.2.2 (Debian 1:8.2.2+ds-0ubuntu1.18)
Copyright (c) 2003-2023 Fabrice Bellard and the QEMU Project developers

limitations: QMP observations are bounded host-visible response times, not compositor input-to-frame tracing.
CPU counts surviving sampled processes; exited processes can consume unobserved CPU.
PSS covers the test UID and excludes the observer and its descendants; root/GDM shared services are outside this scope.
Raw guest samples include startup, idle and workload; host phases cannot partition guest clocks without synchronization.
GPU memory, frame pacing, notification load, multiple cold/warm boots and 24-hour soak remain open.
No release threshold or claim of within-10-percent parity is introduced.
